payload.title: Type Asset — Campaign deliverable kinds (LandingPage, Video, ImageSet, SocialCopy, PpcCopy)
payload.description:
Parked type spec — do not implement. Not in progress.

## Type: Asset (and/or child deliverable types)

Canonical produced thing under a Campaign. **Not a Slot.** Deliverable kinds may be Asset subtypes or child types.

## Kinds

- **LandingPage** — campaign destination
- **Video** — optional; produced via VideoJob; VideoML renders
- **ImageSet** — stills / thumbnails / crops
- **SocialCopy** — channel `linkedin` | `x` (not Discord)
- **PpcCopy** — headlines and descriptions only; **not** live ad-account writes

Older “thing being promoted” shapes (essay, post, repo, case) can still be an Asset `kind` when the campaign is amplifying existing work. Status for evergreen pieces: `live` / `evergreen` / `retired`.

## Fields (design, not schema)

- **url** (when it exists)
- **kind** (one of the above)
- **track**: `hire` | `human`
- **campaign** (parent)
- **status**: live / evergreen / retired (for lasting assets)

## Out of scope

- No schema code
- No Discord social copy
- No journalist media lists
- PpcCopy does not write to Google Ads / Meta ad accounts
